units.source_text: 听见老师的应声，我便打开拉门走了过去，把叠好的报纸轻轻地放在书桌的一角上。

en.t: Hearing the teacher answer, I opened the sliding door and went over, then gently placed the folded newspaper on one corner of the desk.

units.source_text: 老师低着头在阅读什么书，没有瞧我的眼睛……

en.t: The teacher had his head lowered and was reading some book, without looking into my eyes...

units.source_text: 我退出房间，把拉门关上，强作镇静，悠然地从走廊向自己的房间走去。

en.t: I withdrew from the room, closed the sliding door, forced myself to appear calm, and walked leisurely down the corridor toward my own room.
